'''August 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 11 August 2001. [[Paul McKelvey]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2831">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-pleasanton-ca-what-happend-this-timed2831/ pleasanton-ca-what-happend-this-time], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 12 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-12-pleasanton-ca-what-happend-this-timed2831/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul McKelvey]]
